marc:datafield.marc:subfield: MISI RAYYAN & DANISH : JANGAN AMBIL RUMAH KAMI

Two siblings who have lost their parents. Their parents have died from air crashes. But they were left with a wealth of treasures and a great house. Amanda is a personal advocate and the only family close friend is looking for heirs who can keep Rayyan & Danish up to their 18th birthday. Suddenly emerged Katrina, Hakim and Danial who admitted they were the closest heir to the kid's parents. The three of them want to re-invent all the hidden heritage of the estate and the bad purpose of them being known by Rayyan & Danish, then the funny scenes and strategies started by these two geniuses to prevent the heirs who wanted to take their home.
